admin.public_url.description: This must exactly match the public Cloudflare Tunnel address clients use (including any path prefix), because it is copied into MCP connector links and OAuth issuer/resource metadata. It starts from deployment configuration, then an Admin-saved value is persisted in Cognita state so changing it does not require editing deployment configuration. Use an HTTPS URL; HTTP is allowed only for local development.
